title: Connector-neutral invocation and semantic boundary
summary: Direct ooRexx domain classes require no ConnectSelector, RPC Service Core, JSON-RPC Fabric or Queue Fabric. An optional TimeServiceEndpoint publishes read-only operations and can register with RPC Service Core. ConnectSelector determines DIRECT, RPC and QUEUE paths; those transports retain different failure/durability semantics.
invariants: JSON-RPC notification is not durable Queue Fabric delivery.
No Time-Service-specific transport selector or compulsory Queue Fabric dependency.
RPC registration, authentication, access policy and service lifecycle remain with their owning layers.

provenance.claim: Verified against locally inspected v0.9 package source.
